note: 2.9b-e: the source game's dragon's tongue flora (Skyrim.esm FLOR DragonsTongue gives INGR DragonsTongue); the Murkmire kit places it in Argonian ground.

2.9b-e: marshweed is a reed tuft at the water's edge (fauna-hazards.md:99), smoked by the marsh folk; 2.4 m high, seated on its base (designed sink 0, four LOD tiers). The old species, algrass03b, read as agave and sank its stalks; the groundcover tufts carry two LOD tiers, not the runtime's three. 2.9b-p: the medium reed (four LOD tiers) already placed at the water's edge is the same tuft grown taller.
2.9b-e: red first, the node piece; the blue cluster reads as a grey bush at a place's distance.

2.9b-p: nirnroot grows in Black Marsh (fauna-hazards.md:101), a very rare plant that grows near water (UESP Lore:Nirnroot, citing The Improved Emperor's Guide to Tamriel: Black Marsh); the source game's flora mesh, three LOD tiers (interior-farmhouse-v1), 0.76 m. Rare, so it is placed one to a place by water and regrows slowly.
2.3c: a placed clam of the coast holds one pearl; a new one grows in a month (the Oliis pearl lots; item.oliis-pearl's sources).

2.9b-e: tall stems are the lore's rootland mushroom (ecology-encounters-loot.md:36); no exterior kit carries a small mushroom with the runtime's three LOD tiers (floramushroom02/05 are interior-kit rows with one).
2.3c2: the placed ferns are the somnalius fern of the marsh (fauna-hazards.md:98); a frond grows back in three days.
